title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, on July 5.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization notes 126 verified sightings in New England since 1994.
Prof. Eva Garrett argues there's no scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence despite numerous reports.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, and advice columnist, passed away at 86 in Cambridge.
She wrote Dear Prudence for Slate and Dear Margo for The Boston Globe, offering empathetic yet tough guidance.
Margo's friend Meredith Goldstein reflects on Margo's advice about balancing grief while pursuing happiness.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters, allowing two hits in six innings as the Red Sox beat the Athletics 13-1.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, improving their record to 64-51 this season.
Boston's 15-hit offense included multiple high-scoring innings, contributing to a commanding win over Oakland.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive battles at Patriots training camp, enhancing each other's skills.
Despite contract discussions, Gonzalez actively trains against Pro Bowl receiver A.J. Brown, preparing for a challenging 2026 season.
Brown aims for a strong 2026 with quarterback Drake Maye, following a season with over 1,000 receiving yards.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman to start rehab assignment Saturday with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox after wrist inflammation.
The Red Sox acquired Rutschman from Orioles for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez on Monday.
Rutschman expected to catch five innings and bat two to three times in his rehab game.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' premieres on Paramount+, revisiting the iconic character 20 years post-series.
'You, Me & Tuscany' stars Halle Bailey and streams on Peacock, offering a romcom set in the Italian countryside.
'Ted Lasso' returns for Season 4 on Apple TV, featuring a new storyline with women's football at AFC Richmond.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may return to the Red Sox bullpen after a lengthy recovery from shoulder and lat injuries.
Interim manager Chad Tracy downplayed Crochet's likelihood of pitching more than six innings this season.
Crochet is open to returning as a reliever, citing team goals and his past bullpen experience with the White Sox.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found in a Dorchester community garden near Ellington Street.
Residents reported seeing someone leave the snake in a cage by the garden before contacting authorities.
The snake is currently under care at Boston's animal facility in Roslindale; officials seek its owner.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Team White, completing 13-of-16 passes with two touchdowns.
DeMario Douglas stood out for Team Blue, contributing six catches, including a 50-yard touchdown catch against Team White.
Injury updates mention Will Campbell returning next week, while Carlton Davis remains out and likely won't play against the Colts.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich, with nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline, was voted best town in Cape Cod by Boston.com readers.
The town features seven villages, over 20 beaches, cultural venues, and conservation areas, offering diverse activities for all ages.
Highlights include The Port Restaurant's oyster specials, sunset cruises from Saquatucket Marina, and the Cape Cod Lavender Farm.
